title: Knockback belongs on axes, not swords
description: Swaps out knockback to be an axe enchantment.
body:
A change to the knockback enchantment, ﻿simply makes it so you can only use knockback on an axe instead of a sword, making knockback be the first "axe exclusive enchantment".

Mojang really needs to add more axe enchantments, even if its only cleaving. That way every different weapon has a different version of the "sharpness" enchantment (density, power, impaling, yadayada)
